exposures.description: Earlier Route A observations and authorized odd-input packets remain in worker memory; no Route B or judgment files read.
Both literal searches returned current NEP 50 and mirrors; one also returned NEP 47. Those proposal bodies were not opened or used as evidence.
NumPy and JAX supplier manuals mention NumPy 2/NEP 50 behavior. These supplier statements were recorded with current versions, without changing the frozen draft or implying historical availability.

selection_rationale: The two highest-purpose supplier manuals were the common NumPy promotion page (rank 1 in both queries) and JAX's original promotion manual (search 2 provided rank 13), whose weak-kind table directly addressed the partial resolver. The current NumPy C API at search 1 rank 6 was read with a single targeted find request for PyArray_ResultType, counted as one evidence-body request. Older result_type manuals, duplicate NumPy editions, proposal bodies and mirrors were not opened.
